text:
sara_sales: quick heads-up — ACME just asked to expand the POC scope. originally we were validating plain text generation, now they want extraction + RAG over their internal docs plus generation. they also tightened latency target to ~200ms p50. can we still do the 2-week POC or do we need to extend? also they asked how this affects pricing. cc @mike_se @harpreet_eng

mike_se: got it. do we have sample prompts and corpus size? RAG adds an embeddings + vector DB step. if corpus > ~100k docs, indexing time and storage matter. Also need concrete success metrics: p50/p95 latency targets, QA accuracy or precision@k, and acceptable token cost.

oliver_csm: FYI they returned part of the security questionnaire — main asks: data residency, no-training guarantee, KMS support, audit logs. they indicated hosted is fine if we can provide contractual guarantees.

harpreet_eng: from infra POV this is doable but tradeoffs: 200ms p50 for a RAG roundtrip with a large LLM on hosted infra is aggressive. options: 1) accept a relaxed latency target (300–400ms p50) on hosted; 2) move to Dedicated with co-located vector DB for <200ms; or 3) use a smaller distilled generator + optimized kernels and heavy caching. indexing 50k PDFs will need an ingestion job (GPU or CPU bulk embedding) — estimate ~4–12h depending on batch size and instance. also need the eval prompts and expected QPS.

sara_sales: they shared ~8 canonical prompts and said corpus is ~50k docs (mostly PDFs). they attached sample prompts (pasted below). do we need an eval harness?

sara_sales: ```
evals:
- prompt: "Given the policy doc, what steps must a user take to request data deletion?"
  expected_keywords: ["data deletion","contact support","verify identity"]
metrics:
- exact_match_threshold: 0.7
- p50_latency_ms_target: 300
- token_cost_target: "< $0.002/token"
```

mike_se: thanks. that helps. recommendation: split the POC into two phases so we can be successful fast: Phase A (1 week) = ingestion + retrieval correctness (precision@k, recall on sample queries). Phase B (1–2 weeks) = generation + latency tuning and cost runbook. we'll need access to a sample of the PDF corpus (s3 link) and an allowlist for connectors.

harpreet_eng: +1 to phased approach. practical notes: for Phase A we can run embeddings on shared infra and validate retrieval accuracy. for Phase B to meet <300ms p50 we should either 1) provision Dedicated with vector DB on same VPC, or 2) accept model quantization + async retrieval caching which reduces freshness. also, embedding model choice affects cost.

oliver_csm: from CS perspective, call out scope-change to the customer and ask for extra budget/time. I'll draft an SOW amendment template: mention phases, deliverables, success criteria (precision@3 >= 0.75, p50 latency <= 300ms, token cost target), and timelines. we should also surface security Qs before ingestion (SLA on data retention, KMS, SOC2 audit reference).

sara_sales: can you paste the SOW bullet list here? I'll send it to the customer tonight.

oliver_csm: sure — proposed SOW bullets: 1) Phase A — ingest up to 50k docs, build vector index, run 8 canonical prompts, measure precision@k and recall. 2) Phase B — deploy generator with RAG, optimize batching/caching, aim for p50 <= 300ms (target 200ms if Dedicated), measure cost per 1k tokens. 3) Security & compliance — provide SOC2 report, KMS integration steps, and contractual no-training clause. 4) Acceptance — sign-off on eval harness and metrics within 2 business days of delivery.

mike_se: minor tech ask — do we have sample eval scripts? I can drop a tiny harness that runs the 8 prompts against the index and reports precision@k and latency. something like: 
```bash
python run_poc_eval.py --prompts sample_prompts.json --index staging-42 --out results.json
```
This will help them sign-off quickly.

harpreet_eng: note: provisioning a staging environment for RAG (vector DB + ephemeral GPU) is done. deploy-bot: staging-poc-rag provisioned (staging-42) — uses shared embedding node.

deploy-bot: staging env ready — index service on staging-42 reachable at https://staging-42.internal (restricted).

sara_sales: perfect. i'll ask the customer to approve the SOW amendment and confirm whether they can add the extra budget. i'll also surface the tradeoffs (latency vs model size vs Dedicated). target: ask them for a decision by EOD tomorrow so we don't slip the timeline. :thumbsup:

mike_se: I'll prepare the eval harness and a short doc with recommended model/quantization configs.

harpreet_eng: I'll prep a Dedicated cost estimate (monthly) and a hosted-latency profile table.

oliver_csm: i'll draft the SOW amendment and send to @sara_sales for review. we should also note a contingency: if corpus requires heavy OCR/cleanup, plan for extra ingestion time.

sara_sales: thanks all — rolling this up. will update thread after customer reply. :rocket:
